fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: TRANSACTION IDENTIFIER
fields.description: Unique transaction identifiers associated with individual transactions.

fields.name: DEAL TYPE
fields.description: Whether the deal (transaction) is a placement or a borrowing.

fields.name: CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: AMOUNT IN TRANSACTION CURRENCY (CCY)
fields.description: The counterparty balance amount as at close of business for the reporting date in the transacting currency.

fields.name: AMOUNT IN LOCAL CURRENCY EQUIVALENT (LCY)
fields.description: The counterparty balance amount as at close of business for the reporting date in the equivalent local currency (KES).

fields.name: COUNTERPARTY ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the counterparty, such as the SWIFT CODE for the counterparty banks.

fields.name: COUNTERPARTY TYPE
fields.description: Type of counterparty. Either 'Commercial Bank', 'Microfinace Bank', and 'Mortgage Finance Company'
